stances.summary: Corrects factual error about her current employment status
stances.quote: You can’t even get basic facts right, like that I am not a former NYT reporter. I just published a big essay for the magazine I work for last week. I’ve corrected you on this before.

stances.quote: Y’all have made me come back to X just to make clear that those sharing this screenshot and pretending it’s about Mamdani are either intentionally engaging in misinformation or are inexcusably gullible. I haven’t worn my hair like this in three years. This tweet is five years old

stances.summary: EEOC charges Tesla with tolerating racial harassment of Black employees
stances.quote: “Electric car maker Tesla, Inc., violated federal law by tolerating widespread and ongoing racial harassment of its Black employees and by subjecting some of these workers to retaliation for opposing the harassment, the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) charged
